description: ADO-DISCONNECT on a read/write copy: a client static batch-optimistic and a server keyset optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID are opened on one Connection and the first row's ID of each is read; the Connection is Closed; each Recordset reads State, ActiveConnection, RecordCount and every row (ID, S); the client one sets S of row 1 and calls Update and UpdateBatch (Errors of the closed Connection), the server one sets S and calls Update (Errors); a second Connection is opened and set as the client Recordset's ActiveConnection by reference (State) and UpdateBatch is called again (Errors); the stored rows are read through the second Connection. Asks which reads, edits and submissions survive the Connection's Close and whether a reconnect to the same file submits the staged change.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
